notes.title: 🎉 Announcing the Official Release Date for Hammer of Pain! 🎉
notes.notes:
[h3]Warriors, the moment you’ve been waiting for has arrived! ⚔️[/h3]

We are beyond excited to officially announce that [i]Hammer of Pain[/i] will be launching worldwide on [b]October 18, 2024! [/b]🗓️✨ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/67d45e56c442f94c65c971040e95d028596a2d43.png[/img]

After countless hours of development, testing, and refining, we’re finally ready to unleash the full power of [i]Hammer of Pain[/i] upon the world. 
Get ready to embark on an epic journey filled with brutal combat, immersive storytelling, and challenging battles. 💀🔥

[h3]
Watch our newest trailer here![/h3]

notes.title: Large Changes! DEVLOG #1
notes.notes:
[b][h1]😎 Bam Bam Bam!😎[/h1][/b]

[h2]Yo! You've probably already noticed these sudden changes in our design!!![/h2]
Well, let's start with a sketch made by our artist
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/c9794c57e548908cdf06672268dd8b969e0feb93.png[/img]
From the moment of design and concept, it takes a long time until the drawing becomes a full-fledged, ready-to-use one. 

Well, the first stage is over, we add more thick lines, make the final outline definitions and add the first colors. In this case, we're going to use a loud red, delicate white, and crimson to create a bloodshot effect and fill this drawing with madness. 🩸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/332551ec42265e4ce497acc905d02c84bc710547.png[/img]

Next, let's move on to the final touches and strokes. [i]Style text + clumsy strokes + paint drops[/i] 
is what we need to achieve the main goal - [b]conveying emotions through the screen. 

[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/5c4fbc2a32088a10198675066eae04d6889ab8bd.png[/img]

Below, we have also made a comparison of the previous design and the current one. Write in the comments what you like best. 
[h3][b]Your opinion is important to us🐸[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309744/3dc15a08da4608203c840be5b9c52f2b4eb47cb8.jpg[/img]

[h3][b][u] Left or Right?[/u][/b][/h3]

We hope you like the new design better! 


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h2]Thank you for reading the news! We work tirelessly for you to show our products as soon as possible, and your requests and likes will help us make the process 100% 😎[/h2]
